_doc: Engine dev test kit. Spawned ONCE per name+slot the first time a dev character (names in DEV_REVIVE_NAMES) loads a save, in ANY game built on this engine. ITEM NAMES ARE NOT HARDCODED: every entry resolves against the ACTIVE game's catalogs, so the kit adapts to any re-skin. Edit this file to change the kit — no code change needed. 'consumables': each row grants 'qty' of an item matching its role 'tags'; the optional 'prefer' name is used only when that exact name is a real row in the loaded catalog (so built-in games keep their named kit, re-skins substitute their own). 'gear': rule-based rare equipment — perSlot grants one item of 'rarity' for each armor slot; perRange grants one weapon of 'rarity' for each combat distance band (ranged->distant, throwable->far, long->mid, melee->close). A slot/range/role with no match in the loaded game is skipped (never an improvised fallback).
